source.label: Landsat 7 scene ids in krisrs1128/glacier_mapping conf/masking_paths.yaml, footprints from Planetary Computer STAC
source.method: centre of each of the 35 Landsat 7 source scenes (WRS-2 path/row + date resolved through the landsat-c2-l2 STAC collection)

note: One point per Landsat scene (~185 km), not per 512 px patch; the 14,190 patches and their geojson metadata sit inside a 69 GB tar.gz (hkh_patches.tar.gz) on LILA.
